essence: Through solitary recitation the mantra-holder becomes like a wish-fulfilling tree
He becomes lord of all powers and no deliberation should be made about it
Having recited that much, one becomes fearless and lord of all powers
One should be devoted to fasting from the eighth day until the ninth day
Recitation numbering one thousand is accepted as the preliminary rite
